messages:
maria (docs): FYI planning a soft deprecation window for /v1/invoke -> /v2 endpoint. Proposal: 14-day soft deprecate (warnings), then 7-day enforcement. Need docs + SDK + examples synced. Open PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/2890

sam (sdk): Copy. SDK changes: param rename (model -> model_id), embedding vector dim semantics updated, and streaming framing tweaks. We'll keep a compat shim but add explicit migration snippets. I'll prepare an SDK PR with tests.

june (devex): Owners: @sam (sdk), @maria (docs), @leo (oncall). Devex will help surface common user pitfalls in the migration guide. Can someone run a grep for any lingering /v1 snippets across the repo?

leo (eng-oncall): I'll schedule a limited canary rollout once docs + SDK land. If error rate delta >0.5% we trigger rollback plan A. Need a documented rollback command. Deploy-bot will post when canary toggles.

sam (sdk): Quick grep command: `rg "\/v1\/invoke|model:\s*\"v1" docs/ -n`
I'll add a compatibility example to README so users can alias models while they migrate:
```js
// simple alias shim
client.call({ model_id: client.alias('gpt-4-redwood') })
```
Also adding a small test that asserts both model and model_id accepted.

maria (docs): Docs checklist: 1) deprecation banner with dates; 2) update js/py/curl snippets; 3) migration quickstart (what breaks + code fixes); 4) redirect map; 5) smoke tests. I'll own 1 & 3 and a migration examples page.

june (devex): Smoke example (curl):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model_id":"gpt-small","input":"ping"}'
```
Expect: 200, token_count present. Please add to /scripts/smoke/migrate_check.sh and CI canary job.

deploy-bot: Canary toggle scheduled: 2024-06-21T18:00Z. Will post events to #release-war-room.

docs-lint-bot: Reminder: new PRs must pass link-checker and code-block-lint. Broken links will fail CI.

sam (sdk): Short migration snippet for embedding dim change (to include in docs):
```py
# old: returns raw vector length 1536
resp = client.embeddings.create(model='embed-v1', input='hi')
# new: use model_id and validate len
resp = client.embeddings.create(model_id='embed-v2', input='hi')
assert len(resp.data[0].embedding) == 1536
```
Note: call out that some models changed dims; include fallback advice.

maria (docs): Please add a "What breaks" bullet list calling out: param rename, embed-dim mismatches, streaming framing differences, and deprecation of some inline query params. Short code fixes only.

june (devex): I'll draft a tiny troubleshooting matrix with common errors and quick fixes (401s, 422s for wrong param names, vector length mismatch).

leo (eng-oncall): I'll prepare rollback commands and a v1-proxy switch. Putting the operations command here for docs ops team:
```bash
# rollback to v1 proxy
./ops/route-switch --to v1-proxy --reason "rollback: migration issue"
```

sam (sdk): I'll add that to SDK ops/NOTES and include a one-line example in migration docs. Also adding compat tests to ensure shim accepts both fields.

maria (docs): Action items recap: sam -> SDK PR + compat tests + ops note; june -> smoke script + troubleshooting matrix; leo -> rollback playbook & run canary; docs-lint-bot -> enforce lint checks. Target: soft-deprec announcement tomorrow EOD. :rocket:
